anomalies.title: One-Way Mode Multi-Entry Blending Violates Logical Position Isolation
anomalies.description: Bybit perpetual connector operates in One-Way Mode (positionIdx=0). When the strategy receives a second entry signal in the same symbol and side while a previous trade (or remainder) is open, Bybit aggregates them into a single exchange position with a weighted blended entry price. However, the bot's internal state tracks them as separate dictionary entries, creating an impedance mismatch between exchange risk and bot logic.
anomalies.impact: Stop orders from prior trades are either cancelled or rotated with partial quantities, leading to apparent quantity discrepancies (e.g., 6870 entry closed as 8450; 593 entry closed as 822).
anomalies.remediation: Switch exchange mode to Hedge Mode with dual positionIdx (1 for Buy, 2 for Sell) or enforce a strict concurrency mutex blocking new entries while an existing position is open on that symbol/side.

anomalies.title: Funding Settlements Present in Execution Stream
anomalies.description: Bybit /v5/execution/list returns records where execType=='Funding' alongside execType=='Trade'. If not explicitly filtered, trade reconcilers mistake periodic 8-hour funding cash deductions for zero-quantity order fills.
anomalies.impact: Account reconciliation scripts report corrupted fee/pnl statistics if funding records are treated as trades.
anomalies.remediation: Filter all Bybit execution streams strictly where execType == 'Trade'.

anomalies.title: Stop Loss Cancel-Replace Naked Interval
anomalies.description: When rotating or resizing stop orders (e.g. after TP1 execution or secondary entry rotation), the bot sends a cancel/deactivate request followed by a new stop order placement. During this network round-trip window (approx 150ms-400ms), the exchange position has no active stop loss registered.
anomalies.impact: If a violent market flash-crash occurs during this sub-second interval, liquidation or runaway loss could occur.
anomalies.remediation: Use Bybit /v5/order/amend endpoint or conditional order edit API rather than cancel-and-replace.
